name: electron v44.9.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.9.0

## Features

* Added app shims on macOS to show windows under another app's Dock icon. [#55073](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55073) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55072))</sup>

## Fixes

* Fixed link-opened windows not using the opener's session and `webPreferences`. [#55048](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55048) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55050), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55049), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55051))</sup>
* Fixed `setCertificateVerifyProc` occasionally not being applied to a request issued concurrently with the first request to a host. [#55046](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55046) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55054), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55047), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55045))</sup>
